prompt: Create one original wide 16:9 campaign briefing illustration for a stylized science-fiction real-time strategy game. Scene: an ochre desert canyon with a compact industrial outpost holding the canyon entrance. A few squat gray armored tracked vehicles with muted olive-green panels defend gray modular hangars, a chunky command center and a small reactor; tiny utility robots reinforce the construction line. Distant hostile vehicles approach through the canyon, with subtle dust and small amber flashes. Art direction: polished low-poly 3D cinematic key art, clean faceted silhouettes and restrained materials consistent with a readable toy-scale RTS battlefield, convincing sunlight and shadows, not photorealistic military photography. Show a broad tactical landscape with the base and vehicles clearly recognizable, rather than a medieval fortress. Leave the lower fifth comparatively quiet and dark enough for a separate briefing text band. No baked-in text, letters, logos, UI, health bars, selection rings, fantasy castles, human portraits, or recognizable franchise designs. This is an original mission illustration candidate, not a gameplay screenshot. Opaque background.

inspection.subject: gray/olive sci-fi canyon outpost, tracked vehicles and utility robots
inspection.usage: original campaign illustration; not a gameplay screenshot
